android.desc:
Turn your Android phone into an all-in-one wireless trackpad, presentation clicker, gyro air mouse laser pointer, game controller, and PC remote control for your Win or Mac!
Whether you are delivering a PowerPoint presentation on a stage, streaming media on your TV, browsing the web from your couch, or transferring files between devices, AirPoint gives you effortless, low-latency control over your local Wi-Fi network.

🌟 KEY FEATURES

🖱️ WIRELESS TRACKPAD
• Ultra-smooth cursor control with adjustable speed presets (Slow, Normal, Fast, Turbo).
• Tap to left click, 2-finger tap for right click.
• Natural 2-finger vertical and horizontal scrolling.
• Hold-to-drag and dedicated Drag Lock for easy window moving and file selecting.
• Physical Left & Right click buttons.

📽️ PRESENTATION REMOTE & LIVE SLIDE DECK
• 100% synchronized slide advance (Next / Previous) with swipe gestures.
• Instant Auto Slide Pre-Fetch: Extracts and loads PowerPoint slide thumbnails in < 0.5s.
• Live Filmstrip Carousel: Browse real-time slide thumbnails with auto-centering.
• 1-Tap Slide Jump: Jump instantly to any slide in your presentation.
• Start Slideshow (F5) & Exit (Esc).
• Blank Screen (B) / Restore Screen to black out projector displays on demand.
• Live Desktop View: Mirror your PC screen directly to your phone while presenting with multi-monitor support.

🔴 GYROSCOPE & TOUCH LASER POINTER
• Tilt your phone in the air to guide a virtual laser pointer or spotlight on your PC and projector screen.
• Touch Aiming Mode for ultra-precise fingertip control.
• Vibrant color palette: Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, and Violet.
• Pointer styles: Laser Dot, Spotlight focus, and Glow Ring.
• 1-Tap Recenter calibration and axis inversion options.

⌨️ KEYBOARD & SHORTCUT KEYS
• Built-in interactive mini touchpad with gesture scrolling and tap-to-click.
• Full on-screen typing with real-time text input.
• Dedicated modifier keys: Win, Command (⌘), Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Tab, Esc, Backspace, Delete.
• Quick access to Function Keys (F1–F12) and navigation arrows.

📁 INSTANT FILE TRANSFER
• Wirelessly share photos, videos, documents, and archives up to 1 GB between phone and PC.
• High-speed local transfer with real-time progress indicators.
• Files are automatically organized and saved in your PC's Downloads/AirPoint folder.

📺 TV & DISPLAY PROJECTION (CAST)
• Beam photos, slideshow assets, and videos to smart TVs and external displays.
• Multi-protocol support
